verdicts.title: Heavy-Quark Masses from the Fermilab Method in Three-Flavor Lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We report on heavy quark mass calculations using Fermilab heavy quarks. Lattice calculations of heavy-strange meson masses are combined with one-loop (automated) lattice perturbation theory to arrive at the quark mass. verdicts.title: Form factors for $B$ to $Kll$ semileptonic decay from three-flavor lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the $B \to Kl^+l^-$ semileptonic decay process in three-flavor lattice QCD. verdicts.title: Rotating lattice
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present the lattice QCD formulation in rotating frames. We start with the continuum QCD action in rotating frames, and then discretize it on the lattice. For the first test of the formulation, we calculate angular momentum in the quenched Monte Carlo simulation, and confirm that the formulation works successfully.
